meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 让 Claude 当 oh-my-opencode 的发布经理:你给出 patch/minor/major 或明确版本号,它触发 GitHub Actions 发布流程并轮询到结束,核对 npm 版本、GitHub release 和 Discord 公告,期间不做代码复审。
howto.when: 当你提到 “publish”、“release”、“deploy” 等关键词,或要求发布 oh-my-opencode 新版本时触发。

say.note: 触发发布工作流并轮询到结束
需撰写完整发布叙事与迁移说明
明确版本号优先,忽略 bump 参数

howto.what_en: Makes Claude oh-my-opencode's release manager: given patch/minor/major or a version, it triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, polls it, then verifies npm versions, the GitHub release, and the Discord announcement.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "publish", "release", "deploy", etc., or ask to ship a new oh-my-opencode version.

say_en.note: Triggers the publish workflow and polls it to completion
Requires a full release narrative and migration notes
Explicit version takes precedence over the bump input
